item.title: Addition Within 10 Worksheets with Pictures for Kindergarten and 1st Grade
item.description: Printable addition within 10 worksheets for kindergarten and first grade. Ten picture pages where children count two groups, then ten pages of problems with a number line to help, plus an answer key. Comes in color and in black and white to save ink.

item.title: Number Tracing Worksheets 1 to 20 for Preschool and Kindergarten (Printable)
item.description: Printable number tracing and counting worksheets for preschool and kindergarten. One page for every number from 1 to 20: a ten frame, things to count, number tracing, writing practice and a missing number row. Comes in color and in black and white.
